about_short_description.short_description: Launch, manage, and grow your startup. All in one place.

product.name: Firstbase Start
product.description: A platform that automates the formation of LLCs or C-Corps, handling paperwork and compliance for company incorporation.

product.name: Firstbase Agent
product.description: A registered agent and compliance service that manages state filings, annual reports, franchise taxes, and beneficial ownership filings across all 50 states.

product.name: Firstbase Accounting
product.description: A full-service bookkeeping and accounting platform offering accrual accounting, transaction categorization, and tax-ready financial statements.

product.name: Firstbase Tax Filing
product.description: A tax filing service that prepares and files federal, state, and local tax returns for LLCs and C-Corps, including forms for foreign-owned companies.

product.name: Firstbase Mailroom
product.description: A service providing a physical U.S. business address and virtual mailbox with mail scanning, forwarding, and multi-user access capabilities.

product.name: Firstbase Payroll
product.description: A payroll tax registration and compliance service enabling businesses to hire employees remotely across all 50 U.S. states.
